plain_id: Argentina, Brasil, Paraguay, dan Uruguay bertanya kepada Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang anak migran. Mahkamah menyatakan anak tidak boleh ditahan karena alasan imigrasi.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-25/18 (asylum)
question: What does the right to seek asylum require, including at embassies?
holding: The right to seek and receive asylum and the rule against return to danger bind states; diplomatic asylum is not covered by the American Convention.
plain_en: Ecuador asked the Inter-American Court about asylum. The Court said people must not be sent back to danger, but asylum inside embassies is a matter for each state.
plain_id: Ekuador bertanya kepada Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang suaka. Mahkamah menyatakan orang tidak boleh dipulangkan ke bahaya, tetapi suaka di kedutaan diserahkan kepada tiap negara.

name: Pacheco Tineo Family v. Bolivia
question: Did Bolivia breach the rights of a Peruvian family by expelling them within days without hearing their asylum claim?
holding: Yes. Asylum and expulsion procedures require due process, and the family’s rights, including those of the children, were breached.
plain_en: A Peruvian family asked for asylum in Bolivia and were sent back to Peru within days. The Inter-American Court said Bolivia should have heard their claim properly.
plain_id: Sebuah keluarga Peru meminta suaka di Bolivia dan dipulangkan ke Peru dalam hitungan hari. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Bolivia seharusnya memeriksa permohonan mereka dengan benar.

name: Workers of the Hacienda Brasil Verde v. Brazil
question: Was Brazil responsible for slavery on a ranch where workers recruited from poorer states were held by debt?
holding: Yes. Brazil failed to prevent slavery and to investigate and punish it; the Court found structural discrimination based on economic position.
plain_en: Men recruited from poor regions of Brazil were taken to a remote ranch and kept working by debt and threats. It was the Inter-American Court’s first judgment on slavery, and it found Brazil responsible.
plain_id: Pria yang direkrut dari wilayah miskin Brasil dibawa ke peternakan terpencil dan dipaksa bekerja dengan utang dan ancaman. Ini putusan pertama Mahkamah Inter-Amerika tentang perbudakan, dan Brasil dinyatakan bertanggung jawab.

name: Roche Azaña v. Nicaragua
question: Was Nicaragua responsible when officers fired on a vehicle carrying migrants, and then left the survivor out of the trial?
holding: Yes. The use of lethal force was unlawful, and the survivor was denied access to justice because he was not told of or included in the proceedings.
plain_en: Officers shot at a van carrying Ecuadorian migrants heading north, killing one brother and wounding the other. The survivor was never told about the trial. The Inter-American Court found Nicaragua responsible.
plain_id: Petugas menembaki van berisi migran Ekuador yang menuju utara, menewaskan satu bersaudara dan melukai yang lain. Korban selamat tidak pernah diberi tahu tentang persidangan. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Nikaragua bertanggung jawab.

name: Wong Ho Wing v. Peru
question: Would extraditing a Chinese national to face trial at home breach his right to life, and was his long detention lawful?
holding: Extradition would not breach the Convention given diplomatic assurances; but his detention for over six years without proper review breached personal liberty.
plain_en: A Chinese businessman held in Peru fought extradition, fearing the death penalty. The Inter-American Court said Peru could extradite him, but had held him far too long.
plain_id: Seorang pengusaha Tiongkok yang ditahan di Peru melawan ekstradisi karena takut hukuman mati. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Peru boleh mengekstradisi, tetapi menahannya terlalu lama.

name: Random migration checks on roads (Amparo en revisión 275/2019)
court: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
question: May immigration officers stop people on roads to check their migration status?
holding: No. The migration review provisions breached freedom of movement and led to racial profiling, including of Mexican citizens.
plain_en: Three Indigenous Mexicans were pulled off a bus by immigration officers who assumed they were Guatemalan. The Supreme Court said random migration checks on roads are unconstitutional.
plain_id: Tiga warga adat Meksiko diturunkan dari bus oleh petugas imigrasi yang mengira mereka warga Guatemala. MA menyatakan pemeriksaan imigrasi acak di jalan inkonstitusional.

name: 36-hour limit in migration stations (Amparo en revisión 388/2022)
court: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
question: How long may migrants be held in a migration station?
holding: No more than 36 hours; after that people must continue their migration procedure at liberty.
plain_en: A man was held for a long time in the migration station in Matamoros. The Supreme Court said nobody may be held in such a station for more than 36 hours.
plain_id: Seorang pria ditahan lama di stasiun migrasi Matamoros. MA menyatakan tidak seorang pun boleh ditahan di stasiun itu lebih dari 36 jam.

name: Health care for Venezuelan migrants (T-210/18)
question: Must public hospitals treat migrants without papers beyond the bare emergency?
holding: Yes. Emergency care for undocumented migrants can include treatment for serious illness such as cancer, and the state must help them regularise to join the health system.
plain_en: A Venezuelan woman with cancer and a sick child were refused treatment in Colombia because they had no papers. The Constitutional Court said emergency care must cover their serious illnesses.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan Venezuela penderita kanker dan anaknya yang sakit ditolak berobat di Kolombia karena tidak punya dokumen. MK menyatakan layanan darurat harus mencakup penyakit serius mereka.

name: Social assistance for foreign residents (RE 587.970)
question: Do foreign residents have the right to the continuous cash benefit for older and disabled people?
holding: Yes. Foreigners resident in Brazil who meet the conditions are entitled to the benefit on the same footing as nationals.
plain_en: An Italian woman who had lived in Brazil for decades was refused the old-age benefit because she was not Brazilian. The Supreme Court said residents are entitled to it like citizens.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan Italia yang sudah puluhan tahun tinggal di Brasil ditolak tunjangan lansia karena bukan warga Brasil. MA Federal menyatakan penduduk berhak seperti warga negara.

name: The “dirty list” of employers using slave labour (ADPF 509)
question: May the government publish a list of employers found using labour analogous to slavery?
holding: Yes. The register is constitutional; it is a transparency measure based on administrative findings after due process.
plain_en: Brazil publishes the names of employers found using slave-like labour, including of migrant workers in garment workshops. An employers’ association challenged the list, and the Supreme Court upheld it.
plain_id: Brasil menerbitkan nama majikan yang terbukti memakai kerja mirip perbudakan, termasuk pekerja migran di bengkel garmen. Asosiasi pengusaha menggugat daftar itu, dan MA Federal mempertahankannya.

name: Chairman, Railway Board v. Chandrima Das
question: Can a Bangladeshi woman, not an Indian citizen, claim compensation for rape by railway employees?
holding: Yes. The right to life and dignity under Article 21 protects every person, citizen or not; the Railways were liable to pay compensation.
plain_en: A woman from Bangladesh was raped by railway staff at a station in Kolkata. The Supreme Court said the right to life protects foreigners too and ordered the railways to pay her.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Bangladesh diperkosa staf kereta api di stasiun Kolkata. MA menyatakan hak hidup juga melindungi orang asing dan memerintahkan perusahaan kereta api membayar ganti rugi.

name: National Human Rights Commission v. State of Arunachal Pradesh
question: Must the state protect Chakma refugees threatened with forced eviction by local groups?
holding: Yes. The state must protect the life and liberty of every person, including non-citizens, and must process their citizenship applications.
plain_en: Chakma families who had lived in Arunachal Pradesh for decades were threatened with being driven out. The Supreme Court ordered the state to protect them and to deal with their citizenship claims.
plain_id: Keluarga Chakma yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Arunachal Pradesh diancam diusir. MA memerintahkan negara bagian melindungi mereka dan memproses permohonan kewarganegaraan mereka.

name: Louis De Raedt v. Union of India
question: Do foreigners who have lived in India for decades have a right to stay?
holding: No. A foreigner’s right to life and liberty is protected, but the right to reside and settle is reserved to citizens; the power to expel is unlimited by the Constitution.
plain_en: Foreign missionaries who had lived in India since before independence were told to leave. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no right to stay, though their lives and liberty are protected.
plain_id: Misionaris asing yang tinggal di India sejak sebelum kemerdekaan disuruh pergi. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak berhak tinggal, meski hidup dan kebebasannya dilindungi.

name: Mohammad Salimullah v. Union of India
question: Should the court stop the deportation of Rohingya refugees held in Jammu?
holding: No interim relief. The court declined to halt deportation, saying it would follow the procedure for deportation; the main petition is pending.
plain_en: Rohingya refugees detained in Jammu asked the Supreme Court to stop their deportation to Myanmar. The court refused to stop it for now.
plain_id: Pengungsi Rohingya yang ditahan di Jammu meminta MA menghentikan deportasi mereka ke Myanmar. Pengadilan menolak menghentikannya untuk sementara.

name: Md. Sadaqat Khan (Fakku) v. Chief Election Commissioner
court: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
question: Are Urdu-speaking “Biharis” living in camps citizens who can register to vote?
holding: Yes. They are citizens of Bangladesh by law and must be registered on the voters’ list.
plain_en: Urdu-speaking people who stayed in Bangladesh after 1971 lived for decades in camps without recognition as citizens. The High Court said they are citizens and must be allowed to vote.
plain_id: Warga berbahasa Urdu yang tetap tinggal di Bangladesh setelah 1971 hidup puluhan tahun di kamp tanpa diakui sebagai warga negara. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan mereka warga negara dan berhak memilih.

name: Ghulam Rbani v. Secretary for Justice
court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
question: Was the immigration detention of a Pakistani man lawful when officers did not consider whether it was needed?
holding: No. Detention requires an actual decision applying the published policy; without it, part of the detention was unlawful and damages were due.
plain_en: A Pakistani man was held for weeks by Hong Kong immigration officers without anyone deciding whether he needed to be held. The top court said that part of his detention was unlawful.
plain_id: Seorang pria Pakistan ditahan berminggu-minggu oleh petugas imigrasi Hong Kong tanpa ada yang memutuskan apakah ia perlu ditahan. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan sebagian penahanan itu tidak sah.

name: Saudi Arabian Airlines v. Rebesencio
question: Can Filipino flight attendants who were pushed out of a foreign airline for being pregnant sue in the Philippines?
holding: Yes. Philippine courts had jurisdiction and Philippine law applied; the women were illegally dismissed. [Check reasoning on choice of law.]
plain_en: A foreign airline forced Filipino cabin crew to resign when they became pregnant. The Supreme Court said they could sue at home and that their dismissal was unlawful.
plain_id: Sebuah maskapai asing memaksa awak kabin Filipina mengundurkan diri saat hamil. MA menyatakan mereka boleh menggugat di negaranya sendiri dan pemecatan itu tidak sah.

name: Neeraja Chaudhary v. State of Madhya Pradesh
question: Is it enough to free bonded labourers, or must the state also help them rebuild their lives?
holding: Release must be followed by rehabilitation; failing to rehabilitate freed bonded labourers breaches Article 21.
plain_en: Workers brought from other states to quarries near Delhi were freed from debt bondage but left with nothing. The Supreme Court said the state must also help them start again.
plain_id: Pekerja yang dibawa dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi dibebaskan dari jeratan utang tetapi dibiarkan tanpa apa-apa. MA menyatakan negara juga wajib membantu mereka memulai lagi.

name: Ahmadou Sadio Diallo (Guinea v. Democratic Republic of the Congo)
question: Did the DRC breach the rights of a Guinean businessman by detaining and expelling him?
holding: Yes. His arrest, detention and expulsion breached the ICCPR and the African Charter, and he was not told he could contact his consulate; compensation was set in 2012.
plain_en: A businessman from Guinea who had lived in Congo for 32 years was arrested and expelled after a business dispute. The International Court of Justice found Congo broke international law.
plain_id: Seorang pengusaha dari Guinea yang 32 tahun tinggal di Kongo ditangkap dan diusir setelah sengketa bisnis. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Kongo melanggar hukum internasional.

name: Jadhav (India v. Pakistan)
question: Did Pakistan breach the Vienna Convention by denying consular access to an Indian national sentenced to death?
holding: Yes. Pakistan must review and reconsider the conviction and sentence, and the execution must be stayed meanwhile.
plain_en: An Indian man was sentenced to death by a military court in Pakistan without his consulate being allowed to see him. The International Court of Justice said Pakistan must review the case.
plain_id: Seorang pria India dihukum mati oleh pengadilan militer di Pakistan tanpa konsulatnya diizinkan menemuinya. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Pakistan harus meninjau perkara itu.

name: Article 26 complaint concerning Qatar (Forced Labour and Labour Inspection Conventions)
question: How should the ILO deal with a complaint about the treatment of migrant workers in Qatar?
holding: The Governing Body closed the complaint after the government agreed a three-year technical cooperation programme with the ILO.
plain_en: Worker delegates at the ILO filed a complaint in 2014 about migrant workers in Qatar. In 2017 the ILO closed it when Qatar agreed a programme of labour reforms with the ILO.
plain_id: Delegasi pekerja di ILO mengajukan pengaduan pada 2014 tentang pekerja migran di Qatar. Pada 2017 ILO menutupnya ketika Qatar menyepakati program reformasi ketenagakerjaan dengan ILO.

name: Case No. 2227 (United States): remedies for undocumented workers after Hoffman Plastic
court: ILO Committee on Freedom of Association
question: Does denying back pay to undocumented workers dismissed for union activity meet freedom of association standards?
holding: No. Without back pay, the remaining remedies did not adequately protect undocumented workers against anti-union discrimination.
plain_en: After the US Supreme Court denied back pay to an undocumented worker fired for organising, unions complained to the ILO. The ILO committee said the remaining remedies were not enough.
plain_id: Setelah MA AS menolak upah tertunggak bagi pekerja tanpa dokumen yang dipecat karena berserikat, serikat pekerja mengadu ke ILO. Komite ILO menyatakan sisa pemulihan tidak memadai.

name: Undocumented Workers v. United States (Report No. 50/16)
question: Does US labour law protect undocumented workers equally?
holding: No. Barring undocumented workers from some remedies breached equality and the right to work and fair conditions under the American Declaration.
plain_en: Undocumented workers injured at work or not paid in the US took their case to the Inter-American Commission. It said the US must give them the same labour protection as others.
plain_id: Pekerja tanpa dokumen yang cedera atau tidak dibayar di AS membawa perkaranya ke Komisi Inter-Amerika. Komisi menyatakan AS wajib memberi mereka perlindungan kerja yang sama.

name: Toussaint v. Canada
question: Did excluding an irregular migrant from federal health coverage breach her right to life?
holding: Yes. Denying coverage where her life was at risk breached the rights to life and to non-discrimination.
plain_en: A woman from Grenada living in Canada without status was refused health coverage when she was seriously ill. The UN Human Rights Committee said this put her life at risk and broke the treaty.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada yang tinggal di Kanada tanpa status ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Komite HAM PBB menyatakan ini membahayakan nyawanya dan melanggar perjanjian.

name: Sarbananda Sonowal v. Union of India
question: Was the special law for identifying “illegal migrants” in Assam, which put the burden of proof on the state, constitutional?
holding: No. The Illegal Migrants (Determination by Tribunals) Act 1983 was struck down; the Foreigners Act, which puts the burden on the person to prove citizenship, applies in Assam.
plain_en: Assam had its own law under which the state had to prove that someone was an illegal migrant. The Supreme Court struck it down, so people now have to prove they are citizens themselves.
plain_id: Assam punya UU sendiri yang mewajibkan negara membuktikan seseorang migran ilegal. MA membatalkannya, sehingga kini orang harus membuktikan sendiri bahwa mereka warga negara.

name: In re Section 6A of the Citizenship Act
question: Is the rule giving citizenship to people who came to Assam from Bangladesh before 25 March 1971 constitutional?
holding: Yes, by four to one. Section 6A, which implements the Assam Accord, was upheld.
plain_en: Groups in Assam argued that the law giving citizenship to earlier migrants from Bangladesh was unconstitutional. The Supreme Court upheld the law, so those people keep their citizenship.
plain_id: Kelompok di Assam berpendapat UU yang memberi kewarganegaraan kepada migran awal dari Bangladesh inkonstitusional. MA mempertahankan UU itu, sehingga mereka tetap menjadi warga negara.

name: Yap v. Thenamaris Ship’s Management
question: Does a seafarer dismissed before the end of his contract get pay for the whole unexpired term?
holding: Yes. Following Serrano, the three-month cap was unconstitutional and the seafarer was owed salary for the unexpired portion of his contract.
plain_en: A Filipino seafarer was let go early when his ship was sold. The Supreme Court applied its earlier Serrano ruling and said he must be paid for the rest of his contract.
plain_id: Seorang pelaut Filipina diberhentikan lebih awal ketika kapalnya dijual. MA menerapkan putusan Serrano dan menyatakan ia harus dibayar untuk sisa kontraknya.

name: People v. Lalli
question: Can recruiters who took women to Malaysia with false promises of work be convicted of trafficking and illegal recruitment?
holding: Yes. The convictions for trafficking in persons and illegal recruitment were upheld.
plain_en: Women from the Philippines were promised jobs in Malaysia but were forced into prostitution. The Supreme Court upheld the recruiters’ convictions.
plain_id: Perempuan dari Filipina dijanjikan pekerjaan di Malaysia tetapi dipaksa melacur. MA menguatkan vonis terhadap para perekrut.

name: Sto. Tomas v. Salac
question: Is it constitutional to make the officers of a recruitment agency personally liable with the agency for workers’ claims?
holding: Yes. Joint and several liability of corporate officers serves the state’s duty to protect overseas workers.
plain_en: Recruitment agencies argued it was unfair to make their directors personally pay workers’ claims. The Supreme Court said the rule is valid because it protects workers abroad.
plain_id: Agen perekrut berpendapat tidak adil membuat direkturnya membayar sendiri tuntutan pekerja. MA menyatakan aturan itu sah karena melindungi pekerja di luar negeri.

name: C v. Director of Immigration
court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
question: Must Hong Kong itself check whether a person faces persecution before removing them?
holding: Yes. The Director must make an independent, fair assessment of persecution claims and cannot simply rely on the UNHCR’s view.
plain_en: Hong Kong had left refugee claims to the UN refugee agency. The top court said the government must judge the risk itself before sending anyone away.
plain_id: Hong Kong menyerahkan klaim pengungsi kepada badan pengungsi PBB. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan pemerintah harus menilai sendiri risikonya sebelum mengeluarkan siapa pun.

name: Ubamaka v. Secretary for Security
court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
question: Would deporting a Nigerian man who might be prosecuted twice for the same offence breach his rights?
holding: No. The protection against cruel treatment is absolute and applies to removal, but the facts did not reach that level; the appeal was dismissed.
plain_en: A Nigerian man who had served a prison sentence in Hong Kong feared a second prosecution at home. The top court said the protection against cruel treatment applies to deportation, but not on these facts.
plain_id: Seorang pria Nigeria yang telah menjalani hukuman penjara di Hong Kong takut dituntut lagi di negaranya. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan perlindungan dari perlakuan kejam berlaku bagi deportasi, tetapi tidak dalam fakta ini.

name: Tsegata v. Minister of Interior (removal to a third country)
court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
question: May Israel send asylum seekers to an unnamed third country in Africa, and detain those who refuse?
holding: Removal to the third country was allowed, but people who refuse may not be detained for more than 60 days for that reason.
plain_en: Israel planned to send Eritrean and Sudanese asylum seekers to a third country under a secret agreement. The Supreme Court allowed it, but limited detention of those who refused to 60 days.
plain_id: Israel berencana mengirim pencari suaka Eritrea dan Sudan ke negara ketiga berdasarkan perjanjian rahasia. MA membolehkannya, tetapi membatasi penahanan bagi yang menolak menjadi 60 hari.

name: Galon v. Attorney General (family reunification)
court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
question: Is the law barring residence permits for spouses from the West Bank and Gaza constitutional?
holding: Yes, by six to five. The temporary order was upheld on security grounds.
plain_en: A law stopped Israeli citizens from bringing spouses from the West Bank and Gaza to live with them. The Supreme Court, by one vote, let the law stand.
plain_id: Sebuah UU melarang warga Israel membawa pasangan dari Tepi Barat dan Gaza untuk tinggal bersama. MA, dengan selisih satu suara, mempertahankan UU itu.

name: Abore v. Minister of Home Affairs
question: Must a detained foreigner who says he wants asylum be released to apply?
holding: Yes. Once a person states an intention to seek asylum, they must be allowed to apply and may not be deported until the claim is decided.
plain_en: An Ethiopian man was arrested for being in South Africa without papers and said he wanted asylum. The Constitutional Court said he must be released to apply.
plain_id: Seorang pria Etiopia ditangkap karena berada di Afrika Selatan tanpa dokumen dan menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. MK menyatakan ia harus dibebaskan untuk mengajukannya.

name: Scalabrini Centre v. Minister of Home Affairs (abandonment rules)
question: May an asylum claim be treated as abandoned just because the permit was not renewed in time?
holding: No. The abandonment provisions of the Refugees Act breached the right against return to danger and were struck down.
plain_en: A 2020 change in South Africa’s law said that asylum seekers who missed a renewal date had abandoned their claim and could be deported. The Constitutional Court struck this down.
plain_id: Perubahan UU Afrika Selatan pada 2020 menyatakan pencari suaka yang terlambat memperpanjang izin dianggap meninggalkan permohonannya dan bisa dideportasi. MK membatalkannya.

name: Helen Suzman Foundation v. Minister of Home Affairs (Zimbabwean Exemption Permits)
court: High Court of South Africa, Gauteng Division
question: Could the Minister end the permits of about 178,000 Zimbabweans without consulting them?
holding: No. The decision was set aside because there was no fair process, and the permits stayed valid until the Minister decided again after consultation.
plain_en: Many Zimbabweans had lived and worked in South Africa for over ten years on special permits. The government decided to end them. The High Court said this was unlawful without a fair process.
plain_id: Banyak warga Zimbabwe tinggal dan bekerja di Afrika Selatan lebih dari sepuluh tahun dengan izin khusus. Pemerintah memutuskan mengakhirinya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa proses yang adil.

name: Bula v. Minister of Home Affairs
court: Supreme Court of Appeal, South Africa
question: May foreigners who say they want asylum be held for deportation without being allowed to apply?
holding: No. Once they indicate an intention to apply, they are entitled to be released and to get an asylum seeker permit.
plain_en: Ethiopian men held in a deportation centre said they wanted asylum. The appeal court said they must be released and allowed to apply.
plain_id: Pria Etiopia yang ditahan di pusat deportasi menyatakan ingin mencari suaka. Pengadilan banding menyatakan mereka harus dibebaskan dan diizinkan mengajukan.

name: Coalition for Reform and Democracy v. Republic of Kenya
question: Can a law cap the number of refugees in Kenya at 150,000?
holding: No. The cap would force the return of refugees and was struck down with other parts of the security law.
plain_en: A security law said Kenya could host no more than 150,000 refugees, when far more already lived there. A five-judge bench of the High Court struck the cap down.
plain_id: UU keamanan menyatakan Kenya hanya boleh menampung paling banyak 150.000 pengungsi, padahal jauh lebih banyak yang sudah tinggal di sana. Majelis lima hakim Pengadilan Tinggi membatalkan batas itu.

name: Good v. Attorney General
question: Can the President declare a foreigner a prohibited immigrant without giving reasons or a hearing?
holding: Yes. The court upheld the President’s power and held it was not open to review by the courts.
plain_en: A foreign professor was expelled from Botswana after writing an article critical of the government. The highest court said the President could do this without explaining why. The African Commission later disagreed.
plain_id: Seorang dosen asing diusir dari Botswana setelah menulis artikel yang mengkritik pemerintah. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan Presiden boleh melakukannya tanpa menjelaskan alasan. Komisi Afrika kemudian berpendapat lain.

name: Modise v. Botswana
court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
question: Did Botswana breach the rights of a man it refused to recognise as a citizen and repeatedly deported?
holding: Yes. Denying him citizenship and deporting him to South Africa and a homeland breached his rights to equal protection, dignity and family life.
plain_en: A politician in Botswana was told he was not a citizen and was sent to South Africa several times, ending up in a homeland area with no status. The African Commission said Botswana had broken the Charter.
plain_id: Seorang politisi di Botswana dinyatakan bukan warga negara dan beberapa kali dikirim ke Afrika Selatan, hingga terdampar di wilayah homeland tanpa status. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Botswana melanggar Piagam.

name: Malawi African Association and others v. Mauritania
court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
question: Was Mauritania responsible for expelling black Mauritanians to Senegal and Mali and taking their papers?
holding: Yes. The expulsions, the destruction of identity papers and related abuses were serious violations; the state was asked to allow return and restore documents.
plain_en: In 1989–1991 tens of thousands of black Mauritanians were driven into Senegal and Mali and their papers destroyed. The African Commission found grave violations and asked Mauritania to let them return.
plain_id: Pada 1989–1991 puluhan ribu warga Mauritania kulit hitam diusir ke Senegal dan Mali dan dokumen mereka dihancurkan. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran berat dan meminta Mauritania mengizinkan mereka pulang.

name: Workers’ wage claims against Saudi Oger
question: Can workers enforce labour judgments for unpaid wages against a large construction company in financial difficulty?
holding: As reported, the court ordered the company to pay the delayed wages, gave it the grace period allowed by the rules, and began steps to attach its assets.
plain_en: Tens of thousands of workers of many nationalities at Saudi Oger went months without pay. Labour judgments in their favour were sent to the execution court, which ordered payment and moved to seize company assets.
plain_id: Puluhan ribu pekerja berbagai kebangsaan di Saudi Oger tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Putusan perburuhan yang memenangkan mereka dikirim ke pengadilan eksekusi, yang memerintahkan pembayaran dan mulai menyita aset perusahaan.

name: Domestic worker’s claim for years of unpaid wages
question: Can a domestic worker who was not paid for many years recover her wages through the courts?
holding: As reported, the court ordered the employer to pay about SAR 68,000 in back wages and her ticket home; the employer appealed. [Check amount and years.]
plain_en: A Sri Lankan domestic worker said she had not been paid for over a decade. A court in Hail ordered the employer to pay her wages and her flight home.
plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga asal Sri Lanka mengaku tidak digaji lebih dari sepuluh tahun. Pengadilan di Hail memerintahkan majikan membayar upahnya dan tiket pulangnya.

name: Staff wage claims against a contracting company owner
question: Can a labour court compel a company owner personally to pay staff wages that are months overdue?
holding: As reported, the court said it would issue an arrest warrant against the owner if the wages were not paid.
plain_en: Workers of a contracting company had not been paid for months. A labour court told the owner to pay them or face arrest.
plain_id: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan kontraktor tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Pengadilan perburuhan memerintahkan pemiliknya membayar atau menghadapi penangkapan.

name: Employer stopped paying salary without formally ending the contract
court: Abu Dhabi Court of Cassation (as reported)
question: If an employer simply stops paying salary, does the employment end?
holding: No, as reported. With no document showing the employee had been told of termination, the contract continued and wages were owed for the whole period, with gratuity and leave pay.
plain_en: A company stopped paying an employee from mid-2025 but never told her in writing that her job had ended. The court said she was still employed and ordered the company to pay her wages, gratuity and leave.
plain_id: Sebuah perusahaan berhenti menggaji karyawan sejak pertengahan 2025 tetapi tidak pernah memberi tahu secara tertulis bahwa pekerjaannya berakhir. Pengadilan menyatakan ia masih bekerja dan memerintahkan perusahaan membayar gaji, pesangon, dan cuti.

name: Waiver of end-of-service benefits signed during employment
question: Is a waiver of end-of-service benefits signed before the job ends binding?
holding: No, as reported. A waiver or settlement of end-of-service rights made before the employment ends is void under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.
plain_en: An employee had signed a paper giving up end-of-service pay while still working. The court said such a waiver does not count and ordered the benefits paid.
plain_id: Seorang karyawan menandatangani surat melepaskan pesangon saat masih bekerja. Pengadilan menyatakan pelepasan itu tidak berlaku dan memerintahkan pesangon dibayar.

name: Gratuity before one year of service
question: Is a worker who leaves before completing one year of service entitled to end-of-service gratuity?
holding: No, as reported: under the 1980 Labour Law a full year of continuous service was required.
plain_en: A worker who left before a year asked for end-of-service pay. The court said the law then in force required a full year. The 2021 law keeps a one-year threshold. [Check.]
plain_id: Seorang pekerja yang berhenti sebelum setahun meminta pesangon. Pengadilan menyatakan UU yang berlaku saat itu mensyaratkan setahun penuh. UU 2021 tetap memakai batas satu tahun. [Periksa.]

name: Hamton International workers’ wage claims
court: Labour Dispute Settlement Committee, Qatar (as reported)
question: Can the new labour dispute committees secure unpaid wages for workers of a company that stopped paying?
holding: The committee ruled in the workers’ favour and ordered payment; as of September 2019 the company had not paid, and many workers settled for less or went home.
plain_en: Workers of a construction company in Qatar were not paid for months. About 100 who stayed won their cases at the new labour committees, but reports say the money had not been paid months later.
plain_id: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan konstruksi di Qatar tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Sekitar 100 orang yang bertahan memenangkan perkara di komite perburuhan yang baru, tetapi menurut laporan uangnya belum dibayar berbulan-bulan kemudian.

name: Recruitment offices’ challenge to the Domestic Workers Law
question: Are the provisions making recruitment offices bear return costs and refunds under Law 68/2015 constitutional?
holding: Yes, as reported. The court rejected the petition of ten recruitment offices against Articles 17 and 51.
plain_en: Ten domestic worker recruitment offices said the law was unfair to them because it made them send workers home and repay employers in some cases. The Constitutional Court rejected their challenge.
plain_id: Sepuluh kantor perekrut pekerja rumah tangga berpendapat UU tidak adil karena mewajibkan mereka memulangkan pekerja dan mengembalikan uang majikan dalam kasus tertentu. MK menolak gugatan mereka.

name: Qualifications for owners of domestic worker offices
question: May the law require owners of recruitment offices to hold a secondary school certificate and have no disabling physical condition?
holding: No, as reported. The court struck down the third clause of Article 2 setting these conditions.
plain_en: Kuwait’s new domestic workers law set education and health conditions for people who own recruitment offices. The Constitutional Court struck down that clause. The case concerns office owners, not workers, but shapes how recruitment is regulated.
plain_id: UU pekerja rumah tangga Kuwait yang baru menetapkan syarat pendidikan dan kesehatan bagi pemilik kantor perekrut. MK membatalkan klausul itu. Perkara ini menyangkut pemilik kantor, bukan pekerja, tetapi memengaruhi cara perekrutan diatur.

name: Al Sawadi Resort workers’ wage claims
question: Can workers left without pay when their resort closed recover their wages through the courts?
holding: As reported, 59 of the 73 stranded workers won judgments for unpaid basic pay; the rest awaited a final ruling.
plain_en: A resort in Oman closed and 73 workers were left stranded without wages. Most of them won their court cases for unpaid pay.
plain_id: Sebuah resor di Oman tutup dan 73 pekerja terlantar tanpa upah. Sebagian besar memenangkan perkara mereka di pengadilan atas upah yang belum dibayar.

name: Undocumented worker and industrial accident compensation
question: Is a foreign worker without a work visa covered by industrial accident compensation insurance?
holding: Yes. A contract with a worker who lacks work authorisation is not void for that reason, and the injured worker is a “worker” entitled to benefits.
plain_en: A foreign worker without the right papers was hurt at a factory in Korea and refused compensation. The Supreme Court said immigration status does not cancel his right to accident benefits.
plain_id: Seorang pekerja asing tanpa dokumen yang sah terluka di sebuah pabrik di Korea dan ditolak kompensasinya. MA menyatakan status imigrasi tidak menghapus haknya atas tunjangan kecelakaan.

name: Deportation right after an asylum refusal (Sri Lankan nationals)
question: May the state deport asylum seekers the day after telling them their objection was rejected, before they can go to court?
holding: No. Removing them so quickly deprived them of the opportunity to sue and violated the constitutional right of access to the courts; damages were awarded.
plain_en: Two Sri Lankan men were told their asylum objection had failed and were put on a plane the next day. The Tokyo High Court said this denied them their right to go to court.
plain_id: Dua pria Sri Lanka diberi tahu keberatan suaka mereka gagal dan diterbangkan keesokan harinya. Pengadilan Tinggi Tokyo menyatakan ini menghilangkan hak mereka untuk ke pengadilan.

name: Death of a Cameroonian man in immigration detention (Ushiku)
question: Is the state liable for the death of a detainee whose calls for help were not answered with medical care?
holding: Yes, in part. Staff should have called an ambulance when his condition worsened; damages were awarded, though a link between the failure and the death was not found. [Check.]
plain_en: A man from Cameroon died in 2014 in an immigration detention centre in Ushiku after crying out in pain through the night. The court said staff failed to get him to hospital and awarded damages to his family.
plain_id: Seorang pria dari Kamerun meninggal pada 2014 di pusat detensi imigrasi Ushiku setelah semalaman mengerang kesakitan. Pengadilan menyatakan petugas lalai membawanya ke rumah sakit dan memberi ganti rugi kepada keluarganya.

name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 497 (entry and residence of people from mainland China)
question: May rules issued under the cross-strait statute restrict entry and residence of people from mainland China?
holding: Yes. The restrictions were authorised by statute and did not breach freedom of residence and movement.
plain_en: Taiwan limited how people from mainland China could come and stay. The Constitutional Court said these limits were allowed.
plain_id: Taiwan membatasi cara warga Tiongkok daratan datang dan tinggal. MK menyatakan pembatasan itu boleh.

name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 618 (former mainland spouses and public office)
question: May people from mainland China who settled in Taiwan be barred from public office for ten years after registration?
holding: Yes. The ten-year wait was a reasonable distinction and did not breach equality.
plain_en: A woman from mainland China married a Taiwanese man, became a resident and was hired as a civil servant, then dismissed under the ten-year rule. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan menikah dengan pria Taiwan, menjadi penduduk, dan diangkat sebagai pegawai negeri, lalu diberhentikan berdasarkan aturan sepuluh tahun. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

name: Ng Ka Ling v. Director of Immigration
court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
question: Do children born in mainland China to Hong Kong permanent residents have the right of abode, without first getting an exit permit?
holding: Yes. The right of abode in the Basic Law could not be made subject to a one-way permit scheme or limited to children born after a parent became a resident.
plain_en: Thousands of children in mainland China had a parent living in Hong Kong. The top court said they had the right to live in Hong Kong. Months later, an interpretation by China’s legislature limited the effect of the ruling.
plain_id: Ribuan anak di Tiongkok daratan punya orang tua yang tinggal di Hong Kong. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka berhak tinggal di Hong Kong. Beberapa bulan kemudian, tafsir badan legislatif Tiongkok membatasi akibat putusan itu.

name: Director of Immigration v. Chong Fung Yuen
court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
question: Does a Chinese citizen born in Hong Kong have the right of abode even if neither parent is a resident?
holding: Yes. Under the plain words of the Basic Law, birth in Hong Kong is enough.
plain_en: A boy was born in Hong Kong to parents from mainland China who were visiting. The top court said he had the right to live in Hong Kong because he was born there.
plain_id: Seorang anak laki-laki lahir di Hong Kong dari orang tua asal Tiongkok daratan yang sedang berkunjung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan ia berhak tinggal di Hong Kong karena lahir di sana.

name: Gaygusuz v. Austria
question: May a state refuse emergency unemployment assistance to a foreign worker who paid contributions, because of his nationality?
holding: No. Only very weighty reasons could justify a difference based on nationality; the refusal breached Article 14 with Article 1 of Protocol No. 1.
plain_en: A Turkish worker in Austria who had paid into the system was refused emergency benefits because he was not Austrian. The European Court said this was discrimination.
plain_id: Seorang pekerja Turki di Austria yang sudah membayar iuran ditolak tunjangan darurat karena bukan warga Austria. Mahkamah Eropa menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

name: Koua Poirrez v. France
question: May a disability allowance be refused to a lawfully resident foreigner because of his nationality?
holding: No. Refusing the allowance on grounds of nationality breached Article 14 with Article 1 of Protocol No. 1.
plain_en: A man from Côte d’Ivoire with a disability, living lawfully in France, was refused an allowance because he was not French or from a treaty country. The Court found discrimination.
plain_id: Seorang pria penyandang disabilitas dari Pantai Gading yang tinggal sah di Prancis ditolak tunjangan karena bukan warga Prancis atau negara mitra perjanjian. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

name: Andrejeva v. Latvia (Grand Chamber)
question: May a pension count years worked in the former Soviet Union for citizens but not for permanently resident non-citizens?
holding: No. The difference in treatment based on nationality lacked an objective and reasonable justification.
plain_en: A long-term resident of Latvia without citizenship got a smaller pension than citizens for the same work history. The Grand Chamber said this was discrimination.
plain_id: Seorang penduduk lama Latvia tanpa kewarganegaraan mendapat pensiun lebih kecil daripada warga negara untuk riwayat kerja yang sama. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

name: Ponomaryovi v. Bulgaria
question: May secondary school fees be charged to foreign children because their parent lacks permanent residence?
holding: No. In the circumstances, charging fees on the basis of immigration status breached Article 14 with Article 2 of Protocol No. 1.
plain_en: Two Russian boys living in Bulgaria with their mother had to pay school fees that Bulgarian pupils did not pay, because of their residence status. The Court found discrimination.
plain_id: Dua anak laki-laki Rusia yang tinggal di Bulgaria bersama ibunya harus membayar biaya sekolah yang tidak dibayar murid Bulgaria, karena status izin tinggal mereka. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

name: Biao v. Denmark (Grand Chamber)
question: Does a family reunification rule that favours people who have been citizens for 28 years discriminate?
holding: Yes. The 28-year rule had a disproportionate effect on naturalised citizens of foreign ethnic origin and amounted to indirect discrimination.
plain_en: A Danish citizen born in Togo could not bring his wife from Ghana, while citizens by birth could. The Grand Chamber said the rule indirectly discriminated against naturalised citizens.
plain_id: Seorang warga Denmark kelahiran Togo tidak bisa membawa istrinya dari Ghana, sementara warga sejak lahir bisa. Majelis Agung menyatakan aturan itu secara tidak langsung mendiskriminasi warga hasil naturalisasi.

name: Khlaifia v. Italy (Grand Chamber)
question: Were Tunisian migrants held at Lampedusa and returned under a readmission deal unlawfully detained and collectively expelled?
holding: The detention lacked a legal basis and judicial review (Article 5 violated), but there was no collective expulsion because each received an individual identification.
plain_en: Tunisian men who arrived by boat were held on Lampedusa and on ships without a legal basis, then flown home. The Grand Chamber found unlawful detention but not a collective expulsion.
plain_id: Pria Tunisia yang tiba dengan perahu ditahan di Lampedusa dan di kapal tanpa dasar hukum, lalu diterbangkan pulang. Majelis Agung menyatakan penahanan tidak sah tetapi bukan pengusiran kolektif.

name: Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy (Grand Chamber)
question: May a state intercept migrants at sea and return them to Libya without examining their situation?
holding: No. The pushback exposed them to ill-treatment, amounted to collective expulsion, and denied an effective remedy.
plain_en: Italian ships picked up Somali and Eritrean migrants at sea and took them straight back to Libya. The Grand Chamber said this broke the ban on sending people to danger and on group expulsions.
plain_id: Kapal Italia mengangkut migran Somalia dan Eritrea di laut dan langsung membawa mereka kembali ke Libya. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini melanggar larangan memulangkan orang ke bahaya dan pengusiran kelompok.

name: Čonka v. Belgium
question: Was summoning Slovak Roma families to a police station and deporting them as a group lawful?
holding: No. The arrest by a misleading summons breached liberty, and the removal was a collective expulsion without an effective remedy.
plain_en: Belgian police asked Roma families to come in to “complete their files”, then arrested and deported them together. The Court found an unlawful collective expulsion.
plain_id: Polisi Belgia meminta keluarga Roma datang untuk “melengkapi berkas”, lalu menangkap dan mendeportasi mereka bersama-sama. Mahkamah menyatakan itu pengusiran kolektif yang tidak sah.

name: Kurić v. Slovenia (Grand Chamber)
question: Did Slovenia breach the rights of people from other former Yugoslav republics whose residence was erased after independence?
holding: Yes. The “erasure” breached private and family life and equality, and the state had to set up a compensation scheme.
plain_en: In 1992 more than 25,000 long-term residents of Slovenia from other Yugoslav republics were wiped from the residence register and lost their jobs and rights. The Grand Chamber said Slovenia must compensate them.
plain_id: Pada 1992 lebih dari 25.000 penduduk lama Slovenia dari republik Yugoslavia lain dihapus dari daftar penduduk dan kehilangan pekerjaan serta hak. Majelis Agung menyatakan Slovenia wajib memberi ganti rugi.

name: Paposhvili v. Belgium (Grand Chamber)
question: May a seriously ill man be deported without checking whether he would get treatment at home?
holding: No. Removal would breach Article 3 where there is a real risk of serious, rapid and irreversible decline due to lack of treatment, unless the state assesses that risk.
plain_en: A Georgian man with leukaemia faced deportation from Belgium. The Grand Chamber said Belgium had to check whether he could get treatment before sending him away.
plain_id: Seorang pria Georgia penderita leukemia akan dideportasi dari Belgia. Majelis Agung menyatakan Belgia wajib memeriksa apakah ia bisa mendapat perawatan sebelum memulangkannya.

name: Jeunesse v. the Netherlands (Grand Chamber)
question: Must a mother without residence status be allowed to stay with her children who are citizens?
holding: Yes, in the circumstances. Refusing her residence failed to give enough weight to the best interests of the children.
plain_en: A woman from Suriname had lived in the Netherlands for 16 years with her Dutch husband and children but had no residence permit. The Grand Chamber said refusing her one breached family life.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Suriname tinggal 16 tahun di Belanda bersama suami dan anak-anaknya yang warga Belanda tetapi tidak punya izin tinggal. Majelis Agung menyatakan penolakan izin melanggar hak keluarga.

name: Saadi v. the United Kingdom (Grand Chamber)
question: May an asylum seeker be detained for a week for fast-track processing even though he poses no risk of absconding?
holding: Yes. Short detention to process a claim quickly falls within Article 5(1)(f), provided it is not arbitrary; but the delay in giving reasons breached Article 5(2).
plain_en: An Iraqi asylum seeker was held for seven days at a centre so his claim could be decided fast. The Grand Chamber said this was allowed.
plain_id: Seorang pencari suaka Irak ditahan tujuh hari di sebuah pusat agar permohonannya cepat diputus. Majelis Agung menyatakan itu boleh.

name: J. and Others v. Austria
question: Must Austria investigate trafficking of domestic workers that mostly happened abroad before their employers brought them to Vienna?
holding: No. Austria identified the women as possible victims and protected them in Austria; Article 4 did not require it to investigate acts committed abroad.
plain_en: Filipino domestic workers said they had been exploited abroad and then in Vienna, where they escaped. Austria protected them but did not prosecute. The Court said Austria had done enough.
plain_id: Pekerja rumah tangga Filipina mengaku dieksploitasi di luar negeri lalu di Wina, tempat mereka melarikan diri. Austria melindungi mereka tetapi tidak menuntut. Mahkamah menyatakan Austria sudah cukup bertindak.

name: V.C.L. and A.N. v. the United Kingdom
question: May trafficked children forced to work on cannabis farms be prosecuted for drug offences?
holding: No, not without first assessing whether they were trafficked. Prosecuting them breached Article 4 and the fairness of the trial under Article 6.
plain_en: Two Vietnamese teenagers found working on cannabis farms in England were prosecuted instead of being treated as trafficking victims. The Court said this broke the Convention.
plain_id: Dua remaja Vietnam yang ditemukan bekerja di ladang ganja di Inggris dituntut alih-alih diperlakukan sebagai korban perdagangan orang. Mahkamah menyatakan ini melanggar Konvensi.

name: Zoletić and Others v. Azerbaijan
question: Did Azerbaijan fail to investigate the trafficking of migrant construction workers from Bosnia and Herzegovina?
holding: Yes. Despite credible reports, the authorities did not investigate the alleged forced labour and trafficking, breaching Article 4.
plain_en: Men from Bosnia were taken to build in Azerbaijan, had their passports taken and were not paid. The authorities did not investigate. The Court found a breach of the duty to investigate.
plain_id: Pria dari Bosnia dibawa untuk membangun di Azerbaijan, paspornya ditahan dan tidak digaji. Pihak berwenang tidak menyelidiki. Mahkamah menemukan pelanggaran kewajiban menyelidiki.

name: Popov v. France
question: May young children be held with their parents in immigration detention?
holding: No, not in these conditions. Holding the children breached Articles 3, 5 and 8, and alternatives to detention had to be considered.
plain_en: A family from Kazakhstan, with a baby and a three-year-old, was held for two weeks in an immigration detention centre. The Court said this harmed the children and broke the Convention.
plain_id: Sebuah keluarga dari Kazakhstan, dengan bayi dan anak tiga tahun, ditahan dua minggu di pusat detensi imigrasi. Mahkamah menyatakan ini merugikan anak dan melanggar Konvensi.

name: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs (detention at ports of entry)
question: Do people refused entry and held at ports or on ships have the same protection as other immigration detainees?
holding: Yes. The safeguards of section 34(1), including review by a court, also apply to people held at ports of entry. [Check reasoning.]
plain_en: People stopped at South African airports and harbours could be held without the protections other detainees have. The Constitutional Court said the same protections apply to them.
plain_id: Orang yang dihentikan di bandara dan pelabuhan Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan tanpa perlindungan yang dimiliki tahanan lain. MK menyatakan perlindungan yang sama berlaku bagi mereka.

name: Mohamed v. President of the Republic of South Africa
question: Could South Africa hand a man over to the United States to face a possible death sentence without assurances?
holding: No. Removing him without an assurance that the death penalty would not be imposed breached his rights to life, dignity and freedom from cruel punishment.
plain_en: A Tanzanian man was quickly sent from South Africa to the United States to stand trial for an embassy bombing. The Constitutional Court said this was unlawful without a promise that he would not be executed.
plain_id: Seorang pria Tanzania segera dikirim dari Afrika Selatan ke Amerika Serikat untuk diadili atas pengeboman kedutaan. MK menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa janji ia tidak akan dihukum mati.

name: Zimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights and IHRDA (on behalf of Andrew Meldrum) v. Zimbabwe
court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
question: Could Zimbabwe expel a foreign journalist in defiance of its own courts’ orders?
holding: No. The expulsion, carried out despite court orders, breached his rights to a hearing and to free expression.
plain_en: A US journalist who had lived and worked in Zimbabwe for over 20 years was deported even though courts had ordered that he could stay. The African Commission found a breach.
plain_id: Seorang wartawan AS yang tinggal dan bekerja di Zimbabwe lebih dari 20 tahun dideportasi padahal pengadilan sudah memerintahkan ia boleh tinggal. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran.

name: Hadijatou Mani Koraou v. Niger
question: Is the state responsible when its courts fail to protect a woman held in slavery?
holding: Yes. Niger’s authorities tolerated her enslavement and failed to protect her, and the state had to pay compensation.
plain_en: A girl was sold at 12 and made to do domestic and farm work as a so-called “fifth wife”. The ECOWAS court said Niger failed to protect her and ordered compensation.
plain_id: Seorang anak perempuan dijual pada usia 12 tahun dan dipaksa melakukan kerja rumah tangga dan pertanian sebagai yang disebut “istri kelima”. Pengadilan ECOWAS menyatakan Niger gagal melindunginya dan memerintahkan ganti rugi.

name: MRG and SOS-Esclaves (Said and Yarg Ould Salem) v. Mauritania
court: African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
question: Did Mauritania fail to protect two boys held in slavery and to punish those responsible?
holding: Yes. The state breached the children’s rights by failing to prevent their enslavement and by the weak prosecution that followed.
plain_en: Two brothers were made to herd animals and work without pay from childhood. A court gave the man responsible a light sentence. The African children’s rights committee said Mauritania failed them.
plain_id: Dua bersaudara dipaksa menggembala ternak dan bekerja tanpa upah sejak kecil. Pengadilan menjatuhkan hukuman ringan kepada pelakunya. Komite hak anak Afrika menyatakan Mauritania gagal melindungi mereka.

name: Namah v. Pato (Manus Island detention)
court: Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea
question: Is the detention of asylum seekers brought to Manus Island by Australia constitutional?
holding: No. The detention breached the constitutional right to personal liberty, and both governments were ordered to take steps to end it.
plain_en: Australia sent asylum seekers to a centre on Manus Island in Papua New Guinea. The Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea said holding them there was unconstitutional.
plain_id: Australia mengirim pencari suaka ke sebuah pusat di Pulau Manus, Papua Nugini. MA Papua Nugini menyatakan penahanan mereka di sana inkonstitusional.

name: Plaintiff M70/2011 v. Minister for Immigration (Malaysia arrangement)
question: Could Australia send asylum seekers to Malaysia under a swap arrangement?
holding: No. The Minister’s declaration was invalid because Malaysia was not legally bound to provide the protections the Migration Act required.
plain_en: Australia agreed to send 800 asylum seekers to Malaysia in exchange for refugees. The High Court said this was unlawful because Malaysia was not bound to protect them.
plain_id: Australia sepakat mengirim 800 pencari suaka ke Malaysia sebagai tukar dengan pengungsi. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah karena Malaysia tidak terikat untuk melindungi mereka.

name: NZYQ v. Minister for Immigration (indefinite detention)
question: May a non-citizen be held in immigration detention indefinitely when there is no real prospect of removal?
holding: No. Detention with no real prospect of removal in the reasonably foreseeable future is punitive and beyond the Commonwealth’s power; Al-Kateb (2004) was overruled.
plain_en: A stateless Rohingya man had been held for years because no country would take him. The High Court said this was unlawful, and more than 100 people were released.
plain_id: Seorang pria Rohingya tanpa kewarganegaraan ditahan bertahun-tahun karena tidak ada negara yang mau menerimanya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah, dan lebih dari 100 orang dibebaskan.

name: Ye v. Minister of Immigration
question: Must the interests of children born in New Zealand be weighed before their overstaying parents are removed?
holding: Yes. Immigration officers must properly consider the children’s interests, and the cases were sent back for reconsideration.
plain_en: Chinese families who had overstayed their visas faced removal, and their children were born in New Zealand. The Supreme Court said officials must properly consider what removal would mean for the children.
plain_id: Keluarga Tiongkok yang melebihi masa visa akan dikeluarkan, dan anak-anak mereka lahir di Selandia Baru. MA menyatakan pejabat harus menimbang dengan benar dampak pengusiran bagi anak-anak.

name: Teitiota v. Chief Executive, Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
question: Can a man from Kiribati be protected as a refugee because rising seas threaten his home?
holding: No, on these facts. He did not face serious harm amounting to persecution, but the court did not rule out that climate change could found a claim in future.
plain_en: A man from Kiribati said he could not go home because the sea was swallowing his island. The Supreme Court refused his claim but left the door open for future cases.
plain_id: Seorang pria dari Kiribati mengatakan ia tidak bisa pulang karena laut menenggelamkan pulaunya. MA menolak permohonannya tetapi membuka kemungkinan bagi perkara di masa depan.

name: Teitiota v. New Zealand
question: Did New Zealand breach the right to life by returning a man to Kiribati despite climate change?
holding: No violation on the facts, but the Committee said climate change can trigger the duty not to return people where it exposes them to a real risk to life.
plain_en: After he was sent back, the man took his case to the UN Human Rights Committee. It found no breach, but said that in future returning people to places made unliveable by climate change could break the treaty.
plain_id: Setelah dipulangkan, pria itu membawa perkaranya ke Komite HAM PBB. Komite tidak menemukan pelanggaran, tetapi menyatakan di masa depan memulangkan orang ke tempat yang tidak layak huni akibat perubahan iklim bisa melanggar perjanjian.

name: Singh v. Minister of Employment and Immigration
question: Do refugee claimants physically in Canada have Charter rights, including an oral hearing?
holding: Yes. “Everyone” in section 7 includes every person physically present in Canada, and fundamental justice required an oral hearing where credibility was at stake.
plain_en: Sikh refugee claimants were refused without ever being heard in person. The Supreme Court said everyone in Canada has the right to life, liberty and security, and they must get a hearing.
plain_id: Pemohon status pengungsi Sikh ditolak tanpa pernah didengar langsung. MA menyatakan setiap orang di Kanada berhak atas hidup, kebebasan, dan keamanan, dan mereka harus disidangkan.

name: Andrews v. Law Society of British Columbia
question: May a profession be closed to permanent residents who are not citizens?
holding: No. Citizenship is an analogous ground under section 15, and the citizenship requirement for lawyers was unjustified discrimination.
plain_en: A British lawyer living permanently in Canada was barred from practising law because he was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was discrimination.
plain_id: Seorang pengacara Inggris yang tinggal tetap di Kanada dilarang berpraktik karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

name: Baker v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
question: Must officials weigh the interests of a domestic worker’s Canadian-born children before deporting her?
holding: Yes. The decision had to be attentive to the children’s best interests, and the officer’s notes raised a reasonable apprehension of bias; the deportation decision was quashed.
plain_en: A Jamaican woman who had worked for years as a live-in domestic worker faced deportation, leaving behind her four Canadian-born children. The Supreme Court said officials must take the children’s interests seriously.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan Jamaika yang bertahun-tahun menjadi pekerja rumah tangga tinggal di rumah majikan akan dideportasi, meninggalkan empat anaknya yang lahir di Kanada. MA menyatakan pejabat wajib serius menimbang kepentingan anak-anak.

name: Suresh v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
question: May Canada deport a refugee to a country where he faces a substantial risk of torture?
holding: Generally no. Deportation to torture will usually breach section 7, and the person must receive the material relied on and a chance to respond.
plain_en: A Sri Lankan refugee was ordered deported as a security risk although he might be tortured. The Supreme Court said this would generally be unconstitutional and sent the case back.
plain_id: Seorang pengungsi Sri Lanka diperintahkan dideportasi sebagai risiko keamanan meski bisa disiksa. MA menyatakan ini umumnya inkonstitusional dan mengembalikan perkaranya.

name: Charkaoui v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration)
question: Is detention of non-citizens under security certificates, based on secret evidence, constitutional?
holding: No, as designed. The procedure denied a fair hearing, and foreign nationals had to get the same prompt detention review as permanent residents.
plain_en: Non-citizens were held for years on secret evidence they could not see. The Supreme Court struck down the procedure and required prompt reviews of detention.
plain_id: Bukan warga negara ditahan bertahun-tahun berdasarkan bukti rahasia yang tidak bisa mereka lihat. MA membatalkan prosedur itu dan mewajibkan peninjauan penahanan yang cepat.

name: Dunmore v. Ontario (Attorney General)
question: May farm workers be excluded entirely from the labour relations law that protects union activity?
holding: No. Excluding agricultural workers left them unable to organise and breached freedom of association.
plain_en: Ontario farm workers, many of them seasonal migrants, had no legal protection to form unions. The Supreme Court said total exclusion was unconstitutional.
plain_id: Pekerja pertanian Ontario, banyak di antaranya migran musiman, tidak punya perlindungan hukum untuk membentuk serikat. MA menyatakan pengecualian total itu inkonstitusional.

name: Ontario (Attorney General) v. Fraser
question: Does the farm workers’ law that followed Dunmore, without collective bargaining rights, breach freedom of association?
holding: No. The Act gave a process for good-faith consideration of workers’ representations, which was enough.
plain_en: After Dunmore, Ontario passed a law letting farm workers form associations but not bargain collectively like other workers. The Supreme Court upheld it.
plain_id: Setelah Dunmore, Ontario membuat UU yang membolehkan pekerja pertanian membentuk perkumpulan tetapi tidak berunding bersama seperti pekerja lain. MA mempertahankan UU itu.

name: Kanthasamy v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration)
question: How should officers decide humanitarian applications to stay, especially from young people?
holding: Officers must weigh all relevant humanitarian factors and the best interests of the child, not apply a narrow “unusual hardship” test.
plain_en: A Tamil teenager who fled Sri Lanka asked to stay on humanitarian grounds and was refused. The Supreme Court said officials had looked at his case too narrowly.
plain_id: Seorang remaja Tamil yang melarikan diri dari Sri Lanka meminta tetap tinggal atas alasan kemanusiaan dan ditolak. MA menyatakan pejabat memeriksa perkaranya terlalu sempit.

name: Canadian Council for Refugees v. Canada (Safe Third Country Agreement)
question: Does returning asylum seekers to the United States under the Safe Third Country Agreement breach the Charter?
holding: No breach of section 7, because the scheme has safety valves; the equality claim was sent back to the Federal Court.
plain_en: People turned back at the US border argued they faced detention and refoulement in the US. The Supreme Court upheld the scheme for now but sent the gender-discrimination argument back.
plain_id: Orang yang ditolak di perbatasan AS berpendapat mereka akan ditahan dan dipulangkan di AS. MA mempertahankan skema itu untuk sementara tetapi mengembalikan argumen diskriminasi gender.

name: Toussaint v. Canada (Attorney General)
question: Must the federal health programme cover an irregular migrant whose life is at risk?
holding: No. The exclusion was caused by her unlawful status, not by the programme, and did not breach sections 7 or 15.
plain_en: A woman from Grenada without status in Canada was refused health coverage while seriously ill. The Canadian courts rejected her claim. The UN Human Rights Committee later found Canada in breach.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada tanpa status di Kanada ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Pengadilan Kanada menolak gugatannya. Komite HAM PBB kemudian menyatakan Kanada melanggar.

name: Benkharbouche v. Embassy of Sudan
question: Can foreign states rely on immunity to block employment claims by domestic staff at their embassies?
holding: No, for private-law employment acts. The immunity provisions breached the right of access to a court and could not be applied to these claims.
plain_en: Moroccan women employed as cooks and domestic staff at embassies in London were refused their wage claims because the embassies claimed immunity. The Supreme Court let the claims go ahead.
plain_id: Perempuan Maroko yang bekerja sebagai juru masak dan staf rumah tangga di kedutaan di London tidak bisa menuntut upah karena kedutaan mengklaim kekebalan. MA mengizinkan gugatan berlanjut.

name: Basfar v. Wong
question: Can a diplomat claim immunity against a claim by a domestic worker kept in conditions of modern slavery?
holding: No. Employing a domestic worker in conditions of forced labour is a “commercial activity” outside diplomatic immunity.
plain_en: A Filipino woman said she worked almost all day for a diplomat’s family in London, without pay and without her passport. The Supreme Court said the diplomat could not use immunity to avoid her claim.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan Filipina mengaku bekerja hampir sepanjang hari untuk keluarga diplomat di London, tanpa upah dan tanpa paspornya. MA menyatakan diplomat itu tidak bisa memakai kekebalan untuk menghindari gugatannya.

name: Plyler v. Doe
court: Supreme Court of the United States
question: May a state deny free public schooling to children who are in the country without authorisation?
holding: No. Undocumented children are “persons” protected by the Equal Protection Clause, and denying them education was not justified.
plain_en: Texas let schools charge or exclude children without immigration papers. The Supreme Court said this broke the constitutional guarantee of equal protection.
plain_id: Texas membolehkan sekolah memungut biaya atau menolak anak tanpa dokumen imigrasi. MA menyatakan ini melanggar jaminan konstitusional atas perlindungan yang sama.

name: Graham v. Richardson
court: Supreme Court of the United States
question: May states deny welfare benefits to lawfully resident non-citizens or impose long residence requirements on them?
holding: No. Classifications based on alienage are inherently suspect and these restrictions breached equal protection.
plain_en: Arizona and Pennsylvania denied welfare to non-citizen residents. The Supreme Court said treating lawful residents worse because they are not citizens needs strong justification, which was missing.
plain_id: Arizona dan Pennsylvania menolak tunjangan sosial bagi penduduk bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan memperlakukan penduduk sah lebih buruk karena bukan warga negara butuh alasan kuat, yang tidak ada.

name: Zadvydas v. Davis
court: Supreme Court of the United States
question: May non-citizens ordered removed be detained indefinitely when no country will accept them?
holding: No. The statute implicitly limits detention to a period reasonably necessary for removal, presumptively six months.
plain_en: Men who could not be deported because no country would take them were held for years. The Supreme Court said detention after about six months must end unless removal is likely soon.
plain_id: Pria yang tidak bisa dideportasi karena tidak ada negara yang menerima ditahan bertahun-tahun. MA menyatakan penahanan setelah sekitar enam bulan harus berakhir kecuali pemulangan segera mungkin.

name: Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (children in circuses)
question: Must the state rescue children, including children trafficked from Nepal, working in circuses?
holding: Yes. Employing children in circuses was prohibited, raids and rescue were ordered, and the government had to act against trafficking.
plain_en: Children, many of them brought from Nepal, were found working and abused in Indian circuses. The Supreme Court banned child labour in circuses and ordered rescues and rehabilitation.
plain_id: Anak-anak, banyak yang dibawa dari Nepal, ditemukan bekerja dan dianiaya di sirkus India. MA melarang pekerja anak di sirkus dan memerintahkan penyelamatan dan rehabilitasi.

name: Vishal Jeet v. Union of India
question: What must the state do about girls trafficked into forced prostitution, including across borders?
holding: The state must take strict action under the trafficking law and set up advisory committees and rehabilitation schemes.
plain_en: A lawyer asked the Supreme Court to act on girls forced into prostitution, some brought from neighbouring countries. The court told governments to enforce the law and help the girls rebuild their lives.
plain_id: Seorang advokat meminta MA bertindak terhadap anak perempuan yang dipaksa melacur, sebagian dibawa dari negara tetangga. Pengadilan memerintahkan pemerintah menegakkan hukum dan membantu mereka membangun hidup kembali.

name: Writ on Bangladeshi workers who died on World Cup projects
court: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
question: Must the government list Bangladeshi workers who died or were injured on construction projects abroad, and consider compensation for families?
holding: The court directed the ministries to compile the list within a month and asked them to show cause why compensation should not be ordered; the Appellate Division chamber judge stayed the list directive until March 2023.
plain_en: A lawyer asked Bangladesh’s High Court to make the government account for workers who died or were hurt building stadiums abroad. The court ordered a list and asked about compensation. A higher judge paused part of the order.
plain_id: Seorang advokat meminta Pengadilan Tinggi Bangladesh mewajibkan pemerintah mendata pekerja yang meninggal atau cedera saat membangun stadion di luar negeri. Pengadilan memerintahkan pendataan dan menanyakan ganti rugi. Hakim yang lebih tinggi menangguhkan sebagian perintah itu.

name: PERT/CPM Manpower Exponent Co. v. Vinuya
question: Were workers who resigned abroad after their contracts were changed for the worse illegally dismissed, and is the recruiter liable?
holding: Yes. Substituting worse contracts amounted to constructive dismissal, and the recruitment agency was jointly liable for the workers’ money claims.
plain_en: Filipino workers sent abroad were made to sign new contracts with lower pay than promised, then quit and came home. The Supreme Court said they had effectively been dismissed and the agency had to pay.
plain_id: Pekerja Filipina yang dikirim ke luar negeri dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah lebih rendah dari yang dijanjikan, lalu berhenti dan pulang. MA menyatakan mereka pada dasarnya dipecat dan agen harus membayar.

name: Macalintal v. Commission on Elections (overseas absentee voting)
question: Can Filipinos working abroad vote in national elections without returning home?
holding: Yes. The Overseas Absentee Voting Act was largely upheld; Filipinos abroad keep their domicile at home for voting purposes. Some provisions giving Congress oversight of the election body were struck down.
plain_en: A lawyer challenged the new law letting Filipinos abroad vote. The Supreme Court upheld the right of overseas workers to vote from abroad.
plain_id: Seorang advokat menggugat UU baru yang membolehkan warga Filipina di luar negeri memilih. MA mempertahankan hak pekerja di luar negeri untuk memilih dari luar negeri.

name: Rafoneke v. Minister of Justice and Correctional Services
question: May qualified foreign lawyers, such as Lesotho nationals trained in South Africa, be barred from practising because they are not citizens or permanent residents?
holding: Yes. Section 24(2) of the Legal Practice Act was held not to be unfair discrimination.

name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Provisional Measures, Order of 23 July 2018

Part of a series with the CERD decisions of 2019 and the ICJ judgment of 2021.
plain_id: Perkara antarnegara berdasarkan Konvensi Penghapusan Diskriminasi Rasial (ICERD). Mahkamah memerintahkan tindakan sementara, antara lain agar keluarga yang terpisah akibat tindakan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan disatukan kembali, serta agar pelajar dan pihak berperkara tetap dapat mengakses pendidikan dan pengadilan.

name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Jurisdiction (inter-state communication)
court: UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination
plain_en: The Committee held that it had jurisdiction over the inter-state communication and rejected the objection that distinctions based on current nationality fall outside the convention. Key question: does ICERD protect non-citizens against nationality-based measures? Compare the ICJ judgment of 2021, which read 'national origin' more narrowly.
plain_id: Komite menyatakan berwenang atas komunikasi antarnegara ini dan menolak keberatan bahwa pembedaan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan saat ini berada di luar cakupan konvensi. Bandingkan dengan putusan ICJ 2021 yang menafsirkan 'asal kebangsaan' secara lebih sempit.

name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Admissibility (inter-state communication)
