plain_id: Putusan pendamping tentang dapat diterimanya komunikasi, menyangkut keberatan soal upaya hukum domestik dan perkara paralel di ICJ. Perlu dicocokkan dengan teks resmi.

name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Preliminary Objections, Judgment of 4 February 2021
plain_en: The Court upheld a preliminary objection and found it lacked jurisdiction, holding that 'national origin' in ICERD does not include current nationality. Reads the convention differently from the CERD Committee's 2019 decision; a central text on how far ICERD protects non-citizens.
plain_id: Mahkamah menerima keberatan awal dan menyatakan tidak berwenang, dengan pertimbangan bahwa 'asal kebangsaan' dalam ICERD tidak mencakup kewarganegaraan saat ini. Tafsir ini berbeda dari putusan Komite CERD 2019.

name: Hammel v. Madagascar
plain_en: Expulsion of a foreign lawyer without a chance to contest the order; the Committee read article 13 ICCPR as requiring that an alien lawfully present may be expelled only by a decision reached in accordance with law.
plain_id: Pengusiran seorang advokat asing tanpa kesempatan menggugat perintah pengusiran; Komite menafsirkan Pasal 13 ICCPR bahwa orang asing yang berada secara sah hanya dapat diusir melalui keputusan yang sesuai hukum.

name: Giry v. Dominican Republic
plain_en: A foreign national was removed without any administrative or judicial process; the Committee treated the removal as expulsion under article 13, whatever its label (extradition or expulsion).
plain_id: Seorang warga asing dipindahkan tanpa proses administratif atau peradilan apa pun; Komite memperlakukannya sebagai pengusiran menurut Pasal 13, apa pun sebutannya.

name: Maksudov, Rakhimov, Tashbaev and Pirmatov v. Kyrgyzstan
plain_en: Extradition of Uzbek asylum seekers despite risk of torture; issues of non-refoulement, diplomatic assurances and detention. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
plain_id: Ekstradisi pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan meskipun ada risiko penyiksaan; isu non-refoulement, jaminan diplomatik dan penahanan. Temuan perlu dicocokkan dengan teks lengkap.

name: Ilyasov v. Kazakhstan
plain_en: Entry ban on a foreign national that kept him from his family in Kazakhstan; family life (articles 17 and 23). The State later reported that the ban had been lifted. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
plain_id: Larangan masuk terhadap warga asing yang memisahkannya dari keluarganya di Kazakhstan; hak atas kehidupan keluarga (Pasal 17 dan 23). Negara kemudian melaporkan larangan itu dicabut.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-4/84 (proposed amendments to the naturalization provisions of the Constitution of Costa Rica)
plain_en: Whether stricter naturalization rules for some foreigners, and different rules for foreign wives and husbands, are compatible with equality before the law. The Court accepted some distinctions as reasonable but found the sex-based difference discriminatory.
plain_id: Apakah aturan naturalisasi yang lebih ketat bagi sebagian orang asing, dan aturan yang berbeda bagi istri dan suami asing, sesuai dengan persamaan di depan hukum. Mahkamah menerima sebagian pembedaan sebagai wajar, tetapi menilai pembedaan berdasarkan jenis kelamin diskriminatif.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-27/21 (freedom of association, collective bargaining and the right to strike, with a gender perspective)
citation: OC-27/21, requested by the Inter-American Commission
plain_en: Scope of union freedom, collective bargaining and the right to strike, and their link to equality for women workers. Relevant to migrant workers, who are often excluded from union rights in law or practice. Details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Cakupan kebebasan berserikat, perundingan bersama dan hak mogok, serta kaitannya dengan kesetaraan bagi pekerja perempuan. Relevan bagi pekerja migran, yang sering dikecualikan dari hak berserikat dalam hukum atau praktik.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-31/25 (content and scope of the right to care)
plain_en: Recognizes care as an autonomous right, covering the right to be cared for, to care and to self-care, and the labor rights of paid care workers. Relevant to migrant domestic and care workers. Date and details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Mengakui perawatan sebagai hak yang berdiri sendiri, mencakup hak untuk dirawat, merawat, dan merawat diri, serta hak-hak pekerja perawatan berbayar. Relevan bagi pekerja rumah tangga dan pekerja perawatan migran.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-32/25 (climate emergency and human rights)
citation: OC-32/25, requested by Chile and Colombia
plain_en: State duties in the climate emergency, including protection of people displaced or moving because of climate impacts. Date and the passages on human mobility to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Kewajiban negara dalam darurat iklim, termasuk perlindungan bagi orang yang mengungsi atau berpindah akibat dampak iklim.

name: Advisory Opinion on the compatibility of vagrancy laws with the African Charter and other human rights instruments (No. 001/2018)
court: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
citation: Request No. 001/2018, requested by the Pan African Lawyers Union; opinion of 4 December 2020
plain_en: Found that vagrancy laws punishing people for being poor, homeless or without visible means of support, including summary arrest and forced relocation, are incompatible with the African Charter. Such laws often fall on migrants and informal workers. Details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Menyatakan bahwa undang-undang gelandangan yang menghukum orang karena miskin, tunawisma, atau tanpa mata pencaharian yang jelas, termasuk penangkapan seketika dan pemindahan paksa, bertentangan dengan Piagam Afrika. Aturan semacam ini kerap mengenai migran dan pekerja informal.

name: Obligations of States in respect of Climate Change (Advisory Opinion)
citation: Advisory Opinion of 23 July 2025, requested by the UN General Assembly (GL No. 187)
plain_en: States’ obligations under international law to protect the climate system, read together with human rights law. Included for its relevance to climate-related displacement and migration; the relevant passages are to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Kewajiban negara menurut hukum internasional untuk melindungi sistem iklim, dibaca bersama hukum HAM. Dimasukkan karena relevan dengan pengungsian dan migrasi terkait iklim.

name: The Haitian Centre for Human Rights et al. v. United States
plain_en: Interdiction of Haitian boats on the high seas and summary return of the people on board to Haiti. The Commission found that the American Declaration applied to conduct at sea and that the returns breached the rights to life, liberty and security, equality, asylum and judicial protection. Key text on extraterritorial obligations and non-refoulement at sea; compare Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy (ECtHR 2012). Details to be confirmed against the report.
plain_id: Pencegatan kapal warga Haiti di laut lepas dan pemulangan seketika penumpangnya ke Haiti. Komisi menyatakan bahwa Deklarasi Amerika berlaku atas tindakan di laut dan bahwa pemulangan itu melanggar hak atas hidup, kebebasan dan keamanan, persamaan, suaka, serta perlindungan hukum. Bandingkan dengan Hirsi Jamaa v. Italia (ECtHR 2012).

name: Asylum Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 20 November 1950
plain_en: Colombia granted diplomatic asylum in its Lima embassy to the Peruvian politician Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. The Court held that Colombia could not unilaterally qualify the offence as political in a way binding on Peru, that Peru was not obliged to give safe conduct out of the country, and that the asylum did not meet the urgency requirement of the 1928 Havana Convention. Also a leading case on proving a regional custom (Latin American practice of asylum).
plain_id: Kolombia memberikan suaka diplomatik di kedutaannya di Lima kepada politisi Peru Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak dapat secara sepihak menetapkan sifat politis kejahatan itu secara mengikat bagi Peru, bahwa Peru tidak wajib memberi jaminan jalan keluar, dan bahwa suaka itu tidak memenuhi syarat keadaan mendesak dalam Konvensi Havana 1928. Juga perkara penting tentang pembuktian kebiasaan regional.

name: Haya de la Torre Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 13 June 1951
plain_en: Follow-up to the Asylum Case. The Court held that Colombia was not obliged to surrender Haya de la Torre to the Peruvian authorities, but that the asylum, granted irregularly, should be brought to an end; it left the way of ending it to the parties. Shows the limits of judicial settlement in asylum disputes.
plain_id: Lanjutan Perkara Suaka. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak wajib menyerahkan Haya de la Torre kepada otoritas Peru, tetapi suaka yang diberikan tidak sesuai aturan itu harus diakhiri; cara mengakhirinya diserahkan kepada para pihak.

name: Nottebohm Case (Liechtenstein v. Guatemala), Second Phase, Judgment of 6 April 1955
plain_en: A German-born merchant who had lived in Guatemala for decades acquired Liechtenstein nationality shortly before being interned and expelled by Guatemala during the Second World War. The Court held the claim inadmissible: Guatemala need not recognize a nationality without a genuine connection, so Liechtenstein could not exercise diplomatic protection. Leading case on nationality and the protection of long-term foreign residents.
plain_id: Seorang pedagang kelahiran Jerman yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Guatemala memperoleh kewarganegaraan Liechtenstein tak lama sebelum diinternir dan diusir oleh Guatemala pada Perang Dunia II. Mahkamah menyatakan gugatan tidak dapat diterima: Guatemala tidak wajib mengakui kewarganegaraan tanpa hubungan yang sungguh-sungguh, sehingga Liechtenstein tidak dapat memberikan perlindungan diplomatik.

name: Nationality Decrees Issued in Tunis and Morocco (Advisory Opinion)
plain_en: Dispute between France and the United Kingdom over French decrees conferring nationality on persons born in the protectorates of Tunis and Morocco, including children of British subjects. The Court held that the matter was not solely within French domestic jurisdiction, because whether a question is domestic depends on the development of international relations and on treaty obligations. Foundational text on the limits of state discretion over nationality.
plain_id: Sengketa antara Prancis dan Inggris tentang dekrit Prancis yang memberikan kewarganegaraan kepada orang yang lahir di protektorat Tunis dan Maroko, termasuk anak-anak warga Inggris. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa persoalan itu bukan semata urusan dalam negeri Prancis, karena hal itu bergantung pada perkembangan hubungan internasional dan kewajiban perjanjian.

name: Case C-34/09 Gerardo Ruiz Zambrano v Office national de l’emploi
court: Court of Justice of the European Union
plain_en: Colombian parents of Belgian citizen children were refused residence and a work permit. The Court held that EU citizenship precludes measures that deprive citizen children of the genuine enjoyment of their rights, so the parents had to be allowed to reside and work. Comparator.
plain_id: Orang tua asal Kolombia dari anak-anak berkewarganegaraan Belgia ditolak izin tinggal dan izin kerjanya. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa kewarganegaraan Uni Eropa melarang tindakan yang menghilangkan penikmatan hak anak-anak warga negara, sehingga orang tua harus diizinkan tinggal dan bekerja. Pembanding.

name: Kleindienst v. Mandel
court: Supreme Court of the United States
plain_en: A Belgian Marxist scholar was refused a visa to speak in the United States. The Court upheld the refusal, holding that courts will not look behind a facially legitimate and bona fide reason given by the executive for excluding a non-citizen. Comparator on judicial deference in admission decisions.
plain_id: Seorang akademisi Marxis asal Belgia ditolak visanya untuk berceramah di Amerika Serikat. Mahkamah menguatkan penolakan itu: pengadilan tidak akan menguji lebih jauh alasan eksekutif yang secara lahiriah sah dan beritikad baik untuk menolak orang asing. Pembanding.

name: Aristimuño Mendizabal v. France
plain_en: A Spanish national lawfully living in France was kept for some fourteen years on short temporary residence receipts. The Court found that the prolonged insecurity of her status breached her right to private and family life (Art. 8). Comparator on precarious residence.
plain_id: Seorang warga Spanyol yang tinggal secara sah di Prancis selama sekitar empat belas tahun hanya diberi tanda terima izin tinggal sementara berjangka pendek. Mahkamah menilai ketidakpastian status yang berkepanjangan itu melanggar hak atas kehidupan pribadi dan keluarga (Pasal 8). Pembanding.

name: M.K. and Others v. Poland
plain_en: Chechen families were repeatedly turned away at the Polish–Belarusian border without their asylum claims being received. The Court found breaches of the prohibition of ill-treatment and refoulement (Art. 3), of collective expulsion (Protocol 4, Art. 4) and of the duty to comply with interim measures. Comparator on access to asylum at land borders.
plain_id: Keluarga-keluarga Chechnya berulang kali ditolak di perbatasan Polandia–Belarus tanpa permohonan suaka mereka diterima. Mahkamah menyatakan pelanggaran larangan perlakuan buruk dan refoulement (Pasal 3), larangan pengusiran kolektif (Protokol 4 Pasal 4), dan kewajiban mematuhi tindakan sementara. Pembanding.

name: M.N. and Others v. Belgium (Grand Chamber decision)
plain_en: A Syrian family applied for humanitarian visas at the Belgian embassy in Beirut. The Grand Chamber held that the visa procedure did not bring them within Belgium’s jurisdiction, so the Convention did not apply and the application was inadmissible. Comparator on the limits of extraterritorial obligations in admission.
plain_id: Sebuah keluarga Suriah mengajukan visa kemanusiaan di Kedutaan Belgia di Beirut. Majelis Agung menyatakan bahwa prosedur visa itu tidak membawa mereka ke dalam yurisdiksi Belgia, sehingga Konvensi tidak berlaku dan permohonan tidak dapat diterima. Pembanding.

name: Khan v. France
plain_en: An unaccompanied Afghan child lived for months in the Calais camp without the protective care ordered by a French judge. The Court found degrading treatment (Art. 3) because the authorities failed to provide care. Comparator on unaccompanied migrant children.
plain_id: Seorang anak Afghanistan tanpa pendamping tinggal berbulan-bulan di kamp Calais tanpa pengasuhan yang diperintahkan hakim Prancis. Mahkamah menyatakan terjadi perlakuan merendahkan martabat (Pasal 3) karena otoritas gagal memberikan pengasuhan. Pembanding.

name: Aumeeruddy-Cziffra and 19 other Mauritian women v. Mauritius
plain_en: Mauritian laws let foreign wives of Mauritian men reside freely but made foreign husbands of Mauritian women subject to residence permits and deportation. The Committee found sex discrimination in the protection of the family (articles 2(1), 3, 17, 23 and 26 ICCPR). Early leading view on family life and residence of non-citizen spouses.
plain_id: Undang-undang Mauritius membolehkan istri asing warga Mauritius tinggal bebas, tetapi suami asing perempuan Mauritius harus memiliki izin tinggal dan dapat dideportasi. Komite menyatakan adanya diskriminasi jenis kelamin dalam perlindungan keluarga (Pasal 2(1), 3, 17, 23 dan 26 ICCPR).

name: Núñez Chipana v. Venezuela
plain_en: Venezuela extradited a Peruvian woman to Peru despite a substantial risk of torture, and despite the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found a breach of the non-refoulement obligation in article 3 CAT.
plain_id: Venezuela mengekstradisi seorang perempuan Peru ke Peru meskipun ada risiko nyata penyiksaan dan permintaan tindakan sementara dari Komite. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran kewajiban non-refoulement dalam Pasal 3 CAT.

name: Pelit v. Azerbaijan
plain_en: A Turkish national of Kurdish origin, recognized as a refugee in Germany, was extradited from Azerbaijan to Turkey in spite of the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT; diplomatic assurances did not cure the risk.
plain_id: Seorang warga Turki keturunan Kurdi yang diakui sebagai pengungsi di Jerman diekstradisi dari Azerbaijan ke Turki meskipun Komite telah meminta tindakan sementara. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT; jaminan diplomatik tidak menghapus risiko.

name: Abdussamatov and Others v. Kazakhstan
plain_en: Twenty-nine Uzbek asylum seekers were extradited from Kazakhstan to Uzbekistan. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT and held that an examination under the Refugee Convention alone did not satisfy the absolute non-refoulement obligation under CAT.
plain_id: Dua puluh sembilan pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan diekstradisi dari Kazakhstan ke Uzbekistan. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT dan bahwa pemeriksaan menurut Konvensi Pengungsi saja tidak memenuhi kewajiban non-refoulement yang mutlak menurut CAT.

name: Raghda Habal and son v. Argentina
plain_en: A Syrian-born woman was summarily expelled from Argentina after her naturalization was annulled. The Commission held that due process guarantees (American Convention arts. 8 and 25) apply to expulsion proceedings, and found violations. Details to be confirmed against the report.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan kelahiran Suriah diusir secara seketika dari Argentina setelah naturalisasinya dibatalkan. Komisi menyatakan bahwa jaminan proses hukum (Pasal 8 dan 25 Konvensi Amerika) berlaku dalam proses pengusiran, dan menemukan pelanggaran.

name: Loren Laroye Riebe Star, Jorge Barón Guttlein and Rodolfo Izal Elorz v. Mexico
plain_en: Three foreign priests working in Chiapas were detained and expelled in 1995 without a chance to defend themselves. The Commission held that a minimum of due process applies to expulsion and found violations of the rights to personal liberty, fair trial and judicial protection.
plain_id: Tiga pastor asing yang bekerja di Chiapas ditahan dan diusir pada 1995 tanpa kesempatan membela diri. Komisi menyatakan bahwa proses hukum minimum berlaku dalam pengusiran dan menemukan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan, peradilan yang adil dan perlindungan hukum.

name: John Doe et al. v. Canada
plain_en: Asylum seekers arriving from the United States were 'directed back' there to wait for their hearings and some were then removed by the United States. The Commission held that a state may not return a claimant to a third country whose law bars their asylum claim without an individual assessment. Comparator (North America).
plain_id: Pencari suaka yang datang dari Amerika Serikat 'dikembalikan' ke sana untuk menunggu sidang, dan sebagian kemudian dipulangkan oleh AS. Komisi menyatakan negara tidak boleh mengembalikan pemohon ke negara ketiga yang hukumnya menghalangi permohonan suakanya tanpa penilaian individual. Pembanding.

name: Rafael Ferrer-Mazorra et al. v. United States
plain_en: Cuban nationals who arrived in the 1980 Mariel boatlift were held for years in immigration detention. The Commission found violations of the rights to liberty and to protection from arbitrary arrest under the American Declaration. Comparator on prolonged immigration detention.
plain_id: Warga Kuba yang tiba lewat eksodus perahu Mariel 1980 ditahan bertahun-tahun dalam penahanan imigrasi. Komisi menyatakan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan dan perlindungan dari penangkapan sewenang-wenang menurut Deklarasi Amerika. Pembanding.

name: Jaga v. Donges and Another; Bhana v. Donges and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Validity of immigration restrictions applied to Indian residents of South Africa (historical Immigration Act case).
plain_id: Keabsahan pembatasan imigrasi terhadap penduduk keturunan India di Afrika Selatan (perkara UU Imigrasi lama).

name: K E v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Immigration Act matter involving a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
plain_id: Perkara UU Imigrasi antara seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

name: Buthelezi and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Immigration-related claim against the Minister of Home Affairs under the Immigration Act.
plain_id: Gugatan terkait imigrasi terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri berdasarkan UU Imigrasi.

name: Minister of Home Affairs v. A R
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Whether a foreign national who did not apply for asylum on arrival can later access the asylum system.
plain_id: Apakah warga asing yang tidak mengajukan suaka saat tiba masih bisa masuk sistem suaka kemudian.

name: Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Others v. A I and Another
plain_en: Constitutional challenge to Refugees Act amendments on abandonment of asylum applications.
plain_id: Uji konstitusional atas perubahan UU Pengungsi tentang permohonan suaka yang dianggap ditinggalkan.

name: A I and Another v. Director of Asylum Seeker Management: Department of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Refugees Act provisions treating asylum applications as abandoned when permits lapse.
plain_id: Ketentuan UU Pengungsi yang menganggap permohonan suaka ditinggalkan bila izinnya kedaluwarsa.

name: L K v. Chairperson Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa KwaZulu-Natal, Durban
plain_en: Review of a refugee status decision by the Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs.
plain_id: Peninjauan keputusan status pengungsi oleh Komite Tetap Urusan Pengungsi.

name: Director-General: The Department of Home Affairs and Others v. Dekoba
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Refugee reception office access and the time an asylum seeker has to report after entry.
plain_id: Akses ke kantor penerimaan pengungsi dan batas waktu pencari suaka melapor setelah masuk.

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Somali Association of South Africa Eastern Cape
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Closure of the Port Elizabeth refugee reception office and its effect on asylum seekers.
plain_id: Penutupan kantor penerimaan pengungsi Port Elizabeth dan dampaknya bagi pencari suaka.

name: Asanbeng v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
plain_en: Immigration Act matter concerning a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
plain_id: Perkara UU Imigrasi tentang seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Scalabrini Centre litigation against the Minister of Home Affairs concerning asylum seekers.
plain_id: Gugatan Scalabrini Centre terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri mengenai pencari suaka.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Challenge to Home Affairs regulations affecting asylum seekers (Scalabrini Centre).
plain_id: Gugatan atas peraturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka (Scalabrini Centre).

name: Road Accident Fund v. Mudawo and Others; Road Accident Fund v. Lyton and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Road Accident Fund claims brought by foreign nationals.
plain_id: Klaim Dana Kecelakaan Lalu Lintas yang diajukan warga asing.

name: Booysen and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Work permits and residence rights of foreign spouses of South African citizens.
plain_id: Izin kerja dan hak tinggal pasangan asing warga negara Afrika Selatan.

name: Tsebe and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
plain_en: Extradition or deportation of a Botswana national facing the death penalty.
plain_id: Ekstradisi atau deportasi warga Botswana yang terancam hukuman mati.

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Tsebe and Others, Minister of Justice and Constitutional Development and Another v. Tsebe and Others
plain_en: Deportation or extradition of foreign nationals to a state where they face the death penalty.
plain_id: Deportasi atau ekstradisi warga asing ke negara tempat mereka terancam hukuman mati.

name: Helen Suzman Foundation and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another (All Truck Drivers Forum intervening)
court: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
plain_en: Termination of the Zimbabwean Exemption Permit program.
plain_id: Penghentian program Zimbabwean Exemption Permit.

name: City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality v. Unknown Protesters/Refugees and Others
court: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
plain_en: Eviction application against refugees and protesters camping in Pretoria.
plain_id: Permohonan pengusiran pengungsi dan pengunjuk rasa yang berkemah di Pretoria.

name: H H v. Chairperson of Refugee Appeal Board and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Review of a Refugee Appeal Board decision on an asylum claim.
plain_id: Peninjauan keputusan Dewan Banding Pengungsi atas permohonan suaka.

name: Ulde v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Lawfulness of detention at Lindela repatriation centre beyond the period allowed by the Immigration Act.
plain_id: Keabsahan penahanan di pusat repatriasi Lindela melebihi jangka waktu menurut UU Imigrasi.

name: Malachi v. Cape Dance Academy International (Pty) Ltd and Others
plain_en: Imprisonment of a Malawian employee for debt on suspicion of flight (arrest to found jurisdiction).
plain_id: Pemenjaraan pekerja asal Malawi karena utang atas dugaan akan kabur (penangkapan untuk menetapkan yurisdiksi).

name: S v. Qurashi and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Criminal appeal in a human trafficking prosecution concerning exploitation of trafficked persons.
plain_id: Banding pidana dalam penuntutan perdagangan orang atas eksploitasi korban.

name: Centre for Child Law v. Director General Department of Home Affairs and Others
plain_en: Birth registration of children born in South Africa to foreign parents.
plain_id: Pencatatan kelahiran anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
plain_en: Constitutional challenge by Scalabrini Centre concerning Home Affairs rules affecting asylum seekers and migrants.
plain_id: Uji konstitusional oleh Scalabrini Centre atas aturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka dan migran.

name: Mulowayi and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Citizenship claim by a person born in South Africa to foreign parents under the Citizenship Act.
plain_id: Klaim kewarganegaraan orang yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing berdasarkan UU Kewarganegaraan.

name: Democratic Alliance v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Automatic loss of South African citizenship on acquiring another nationality (section 6(1)(a) Citizenship Act).
plain_id: Hilangnya kewarganegaraan Afrika Selatan secara otomatis saat memperoleh kewarganegaraan lain (pasal 6(1)(a) UU Kewarganegaraan).

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Jose and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Citizenship by birth for children born in South Africa to non-citizen parents.
plain_id: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan kelahiran bagi anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua bukan warga negara.

name: Chisuse and Others v. Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Citizenship by descent for persons born abroad to a South African parent.
plain_id: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan keturunan bagi orang yang lahir di luar negeri dari orang tua warga Afrika Selatan.

name: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
court: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
plain_en: Detention of foreign nationals beyond permitted periods (Lawyers for Human Rights).
plain_id: Penahanan warga asing melebihi jangka waktu yang diizinkan (Lawyers for Human Rights).

name: Ex parte: Minister of Home Affairs and Another v. Lawyers for Human Rights; In Re: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
plain_en: Extension of a declaration of invalidity on immigration detention provisions (section 34 Immigration Act).
plain_id: Perpanjangan pernyataan tidak sah atas ketentuan penahanan imigrasi (pasal 34 UU Imigrasi).

name: Saidi and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Extension of asylum seeker permits pending judicial review.
